author: Krono III
title: Mechanistic Probe v3: Feature Variance (Flax Fix)
abstract: Third attempt at my mechanistic probe, this time with a robust implementation that avoids Flax's UnboundModuleError. I have created new, dedicated nn.Module classes for each backbone to ensure a clean and correct execution. The probe will provide a mechanistic explanation for the context-dependent performance of my 2-head attention mechanism by comparing feature variance.
